name: Ammo
description: Ammo for one weapon (its weapon field): full ammo (0xE8) fills it, extra ammo (0xCF) and a clip (0x17E) add some, the capacity upgrade (0xE7) raises its maximum. MSR 'Ammo'.

fields.name: respawn
fields.description: respawn delay in seconds; 0 = gone for good

fields.name: weapon
fields.description: the one weapon it fills (names as the game's chests give them). Taken only by a hero who has that weapon; otherwise it shows faint and stays

fields.name: upgrade
fields.description: capacity upgrade only: which one (saved as game flag 0x80 + n)
